required_outputs: normalized typed obligation portfolio with provenance/disposition

diagnostics.independent_causal_roots: Count distinct source causal roots represented in selected architecture.
diagnostics.owner_concentration: Share of planned transactions owned by top owner.
diagnostics.multi_owner_sequence_fraction: Sequences with >=2 meaningful owners / all sequences.
diagnostics.multi_kind_sequence_fraction: Sequences with >=2 obligation kinds / all sequences.
diagnostics.thread_intersection_count: Justified cross-root intersections; forced intersections are defects.
diagnostics.multi_function_scene_fraction: Scenes with >=2 protected narrative functions that are not redundant aliases.
diagnostics.pure_supporting_scene_fraction: Scenes with no protagonist where organically justified.
diagnostics.single_causal_spine_test: Whether all selected strands can be reduced to downstream subproblems of one initiating event.

hard_fail: single causal spine caused by collapsing independent roots into one logistics/procedural chain
quota padding or mechanical obligation cloning
no_quota_note: No fixed minimum is imposed for thread count, pure-supporting share, or multi-function-scene share beyond preserving the fixture's causally relevant obligations. Human corpus values are diagnostic priors only.
